correctness.rationale: All initial-source types were conditioned explicitly. Independent geometric time-to-hub and min-of-k geometric time-to-leaf yield exact convolution; subtracting gives a factored finite-horizon CDF difference for every n>=3, 2<=k<=n-1 and p in (0,1). Its positive time factor proves first-order stochastic dominance and the monotone geometric sum gives the unique switch. Integrating tails establishes exact expectations. The independent exponential-clock convolution proves the CT contrast. Standalone exact-rational transition enumeration supplied 5797 checks for small graphs; these finite tests are corroboration, not infinity proof.

value.rationale: A natural epidemic early-warning design must select monitored vertices before knowing the source or deadline. The exact result solves all k-subset placements on stars for every finite deadline simultaneously, identifies the sharp change of hub/leaf preference as transmissibility varies, and proves that this change disappears in the continuous-time limit. It is a substantive exact complete classification of a natural benchmark and demonstrates time-discretization sensitivity; it is not merely a code check, arbitrary finite census, or a restatement of submodularity.
